turns.text: Don't let fear hold you back from trying new things when good opportunities arise.
turns.zh: 好机会来了的时候，别让恐惧拦着你，不敢去尝试新东西。

turns.text: And maybe once I start taking some classes, I'll have a much better sense of what really interests me and where my natural strengths actually lie.
turns.zh: 而且说不定等我开始上一些课之后，我会更清楚自己到底对什么真正感兴趣，以及我真正的长处到底在哪儿。

turns.text: You're an intelligent, thoughtful young man, and I have total faith in your ability to figure all this out successfully.
turns.zh: 你是个聪明、有想法的年轻人，我完全相信你有能力把这一切都搞定。

turns.text: That really means everything to me.
turns.zh: 这对我来说真的意味着一切。
